critical_code_review_comments: admin_users_edit (server.py:650) updates role/email/name but does NOT re-validate payload.role against body role typos early — currently 400 is raised correctly but body.email is typed EmailStr so Pydantic will reject invalid formats at parse time (good). Consider also trimming name to a max-length (e.g. 120) to prevent DOS-style long names.

Self-demote check uses str(target['_id']) == str(admin['_id']) — fine. However there is NO check preventing the last admin from being demoted by ANOTHER admin. Low-risk today (only Isaac), but if a second admin exists they could demote each other into a state with zero admins. Consider guarding with 'if body.role==user and (await db.users.count_documents({role:admin}))<=1: 400 last admin'.

CMSIn has 14 optional fields; consider extracting default values into a module-level DEFAULT_CMS dict that both /startup backfill and a /api/admin/cms/reset endpoint could share, to simplify ops and avoid drift.
Settings.jsx renders help-phone href as tel:8259623425 (strips dashes) which is correct for dial intent, but the visible text shows '825-962-3425' — ok, but add aria-label for screen readers.

/app/frontend/src/pages/Learn.jsx ChoicesView resets pickedCorrect after 800ms while CorrectPulse internally exits after 700ms — both work but the two timers aren't centralized. Consider lifting the pulse timing into CorrectPulse and let it handle state with onExit callback for cleanliness.
stripe_webhook still falls back to json.loads when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is blank (dev-friendly). Carry-over note from iter10: guard this with an env flag before production deploy.
